People were freaking the fuck out about this stuff back in the late '90s. So what did we do? Well, we found some kind of beetle (I forget the species name) which loooooooooves purple loosestrife, and our native birds looooooove those beetles. You release three or four breeding pairs in a loosestrife-infested swamp, come back a year later, and the ecosystem has begun repairing itself.
